What the brief shows as positive: the coin is alive, the class is ORGANIC with no airdrop dump, and the first two minutes after graduation had 429 buyers excluding our agent, with top-5 buyer share at 12%. Buyer count is real, and 279 buyers in the last 15 minutes is not nothing.

What undermines it more: the last 15 minutes show net flow of -1.2 SOL, with sell volume (112.0) slightly exceeding buy volume (110.8) and sellers (250) nearly matching buyers (279). That is distribution, not accumulation. Price is down 92% from the 30-minute high and 85% over 30 minutes. Sell-to-buy ratio in the early post-graduation window was 0.966. Bundle share of 76% points to coordinated early buying, which is a warning sign for organic demand. Pool depth of 33.8 SOL means a $20 ticket moves price and round-trip costs will be at the high end.

No honest case says demand here will still be present in 30 to 60 minutes. The only argument for a buy is a dead-cat bounce, and the base rates say a dip in a coin this far off its high rarely recovers. My recommendation is to skip.
